title: Emberlung Vent
text: A ruptured ember-lung feeds nearby hostiles. On failure, suffer 1 Wound and fix this Hazard to the sector. While fixed, Enemies here and in adjacent sectors gain +1 difficulty. A successful clear removes it.
flavor: The Engine exhales through every borrowed weapon.

successEffect.text: You sealed the Emberlung Vent and marked its cooled alloy for recovery.
